articles.title: SkillFlow: Scalable and Efficient Agent Skill Retrieval System
articles.abstract: AI agents can extend their capabilities at inference time by loading reusable skills into context, yet equipping an agent with too many skills, particularly irrelevant ones, degrades performance. As community-driven skill repositories grow, agents need a way to selectively retrieve only the most relevant skills from a large library. We present SkillFlow, the first open, multi-stage retrieval system for agent skill discovery that frames skill acquisition as an information retrieval problem over a corpus of ~35K community-contributed SKILL.md definitions indexed from GitHub. The pipeline progressively narrows a large candidate set through four stages (dense retrieval, two rounds of cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based selection), balancing recall and precision at each stage. We evaluate SkillFlow on two coding benchmarks: SkillsBench, a benchmark of 87 tasks and 229 matched skills; and Terminal-Bench, a benchmark that provides only 89 tasks, and no matched skills. On SkillsBench, SkillFlow-retrieved skills raise Pass@1 from 9.2% to 16.4% (+78.3%, $p_{adj} = 3.64 \times 10^{-2}$), reaching 84.1% of the oracle ceiling, while on Terminal-Bench, agents readily use the retrieved skills (70.1% use rate) yet show no performance gain, revealing that retrieval alone is insufficient when the corpus lacks high-quality, executable skills for the target domain. SkillFlow demonstrates that framing skill acquisition as an information retrieval task is an effective strategy, and that the practical impact of skill-augmented agents hinges on corpus coverage and skill quality, particularly the density of runnable code and bundled artifacts. (GitHub: https://github.com/IBPA/skill-flow)
articles.titleCn: SkillFlow：可扩展且高效的智能体技能检索系统
articles.abstractCn: AI代理可以通过在推理时将可重用技能加载到上下文中来扩展其能力，然而赋予代理过多技能，尤其是无关技能，会降低性能。随着社区驱动的技能库的扩展，代理需要一种方法来从大型库中筛选出最相关的技能。我们提出了SkillFlow，这是第一个开放的、多阶段检索系统，用于代理技能发现，它将技能获取视为一个信息检索问题，针对从GitHub索引的约35K个社区贡献的SKILL.md定义语料库进行处理。该流程通过四个阶段（密集检索、两轮交叉编码器重新排序和基于LLM的选择）逐步缩小大型候选集，并在每个阶段平衡召回率和精确率。我们在两个编码基准上评估了SkillFlow：SkillsBench，一个包含87个任务和229个匹配技能的基准；以及Terminal-Bench，一个只提供89个任务且没有匹配技能的基准。在SkillsBench上，SkillFlow检索的技能将Pass@1从9.2%提高到16.4%（+78.3%，$p_{adj} = 3.64 \times 10^{-2}$），达到了84.1%的预言上限，而在Terminal-Bench上，代理虽然 readily 使用了检索到的技能（使用率为70.1%），但并未表现出性能提升，这表明当语料库缺乏针对目标领域的高质量、可执行技能时，仅靠检索是不够的。SkillFlow证明，将技能获取视为信息检索任务是一种有效的策略，而技能增强代理的实际影响取决于语料库覆盖范围和技能质量，尤其是可运行代码的密度和捆绑的工件。

articles.title: MedHal: a Synthetic Dataset for Medical Hallucination Detection
articles.abstract: Hallucination, the generation of non factual content by AI systems, poses serious risks in medical contexts, where errors can directly affect patient outcomes. We present MedHal, a large-scale dataset specifically designed to assess capabilities and train models on the task of hallucination detection in medical texts. Current hallucination detection methods face significant limitations when applied to specialized domains like medicine, where they can have disastrous consequences. MedHal addresses this issue by incorporating diverse medical text sources and tasks covering both intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations, and by providing a substantial volume of data samples suitable for training medical hallucination detection models. We demonstrate MedHal's utility by training and evaluating a baseline medical hallucination detection model, showing improvements over general-purpose hallucination detection approaches. This resource enables more efficient evaluation and training of medical text generation systems while reducing reliance on costly expert review, potentially accelerating the development of medical AI research.

articles.titleCn: MedHal：用于医疗幻觉检测的综合数据集
articles.abstractCn: 幻觉，即AI系统生成非事实性内容，在医疗场景中存在严重风险，错误可能直接影响患者结果。我们提出了MedHal，一个大规模数据集，专门用于评估能力并在医疗文本中的幻觉检测任务上训练模型。当前幻觉检测方法在应用于医学等专门领域时面临重大局限，可能导致灾难性后果。MedHal通过整合多样化的医学文本来源和任务，涵盖内在和外在幻觉，并提供大量适合训练医学幻觉检测模型的数据样本，解决了这一问题。我们通过训练和评估一个基准医学幻觉检测模型，展示了MedHal的效用，表明其优于通用幻觉检测方法。该资源能够更高效地评估和训练医学文本生成系统，减少对昂贵专家审查的依赖，可能加速医学AI研究的发展。

articles.title: From ASR to ASP: Evaluating Prompt Attack Vulnerabilities Against Open-Source LLMs
articles.abstract: Recent studies demonstrate that Large Language Models (LLMs) are vulnerable to attacks that generate harmful or sensitive outputs. As open-source LLMs are increasingly adopted in high-impact applications such as finance, law, and healthcare, systematically investigating their security risks is becoming increasingly important towards a trustworthy LLM era. This paper comprehensively studies effective prompt injection attacks against 14 widely used open-source and three closed-source LLMs on five attack benchmarks. Moreover, existing evaluation metrics mostly only consider the attack success rate, overlooking uncertainty in model responses. Our proposed Attack Success Probability (ASP) additionally captures uncertain behaviors for evaluation, where the model may initially refuse a harmful request but subsequently provide harmful guidance or vice versa, reflecting inconsistency and ambiguity in attack feasibility. By systematically analyzing the effectiveness of prompt injection attacks, we propose a straightforward and effective hypnotism attack; results show that this attack causes aligned language models, including StableLM2, Mistral, Openchat, and Vicuna, to generate objectionable behaviors, achieving around 90% ASP. We also find that moderately well-known LLMs exhibit higher vulnerability to prompt injection attacks, highlighting the need to raise public awareness and prioritize efficient mitigation strategies.
articles.titleCn: 从语音识别到自动语音处理：评估开源大型语言模型的提示攻击漏洞
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）容易受到攻击，从而生成有害或敏感的输出。随着开源LLMs越来越多地应用于金融、法律和医疗等高风险领域，系统地调查其安全风险对于构建值得信赖的LLMs时代变得越来越重要。本文全面研究了针对14个广泛使用的开源模型和3个闭源模型在5个攻击基准上的有效提示注入攻击。此外，现有的评估指标大多只考虑攻击成功率，而忽略了模型响应中的不确定性。我们提出的攻击成功率（ASP）指标额外捕捉了评估中的不确定性行为，即模型可能最初拒绝有害请求但随后提供有害指导，反之亦然，反映了攻击可行性的不一致性和模糊性。通过系统地分析提示注入攻击的有效性，我们提出了一种简单而有效的催眠攻击；结果表明，这种攻击导致包括StableLM2、Mistral、Openchat和Vicuna在内的对齐语言模型生成可争议行为，实现了约90%的ASP。我们还发现，中等知名度的LLMs更容易受到提示注入攻击，这凸显了提高公众意识并优先制定高效缓解策略的必要性。

articles.title: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design
articles.abstract: Reasoning models represented by the Deepseek-R1-Distill series have been widely adopted by the open-source community due to their strong performance in mathematics, science, programming, and other domains. However, our study reveals that their benchmark evaluation results are subject to significant fluctuations caused by various factors. Subtle differences in evaluation conditions can lead to substantial variations in results. Similar phenomena are observed in other open-source inference models fine-tuned based on the Deepseek-R1-Distill series, as well as in the QwQ-32B model, making their claimed performance improvements difficult to reproduce reliably. Therefore, we advocate for the establishment of a more rigorous paradigm for model performance evaluation and present our empirical assessments of the Deepseek-R1-Distill series models.
articles.titleCn: 评估即一切：通过评估设计对大型语言模型推理能力的策略性夸大
articles.abstractCn: 由Deepseek-R1-Distill系列所代表的推理模型因其强大的数学、科学、编程等领域的性能，已被开源社区广泛采用。然而，我们的研究表明，它们的基准评估结果会受到多种因素的影响而出现显著波动。评估条件的细微差异可能导致结果的巨大变化。在其他基于Deepseek-R1-Distill系列进行微调的开源推理模型以及QwQ-32B模型中，也观察到了类似现象，这使得它们声称的性能提升难以可靠地复现。因此，我们倡导建立更严格的模型性能评估范式，并展示了我们对Deepseek-R1-Distill系列模型的实证评估结果。

articles.title: Does Understanding Inform Generation in Unified Multimodal Models? From Analysis to Path Forward
articles.abstract: Recent years have witnessed significant progress in Unified Multimodal Models, yet a fundamental question remains: Does understanding truly inform generation in Unified Multimodal Models? To investigate this, we introduce UniSandbox, a decoupled evaluation framework paired with controlled, synthetic datasets to avoid data leakage and enable detailed analysis. Our findings reveal a significant understanding-generation gap, which is mainly reflected in two key dimensions: reasoning generation and knowledge transfer. Specifically, for reasoning generation tasks, we observe that explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) in the understanding module effectively bridges the gap, and further demonstrate that a self-training approach can successfully internalize this ability, enabling implicit reasoning during generation. Additionally, for knowledge transfer tasks, we find that CoT assists the generative process by helping retrieve newly learned knowledge, and also discover that query-based architectures inherently exhibit latent CoT-like properties that affect this transfer. UniSandbox provides preliminary insights for designing future unified architectures and training strategies that truly bridge the understanding-generation gap.
articles.titleCn: 理解是否统一多模态模型中的生成？从分析到前进的方向
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，统一多模态模型取得了显著进展，但一个基本问题仍然存在：理解是否真的能指导统一多模态模型的生成？为了探究这一问题，我们引入了UniSandbox，这是一个解耦的评估框架，搭配可控的合成数据集以避免数据泄露并支持详细分析。我们的研究发现存在显著的理解-生成差距，这主要体现在两个关键维度：推理生成和知识迁移。具体而言，对于推理生成任务，我们观察到理解模块中的显式思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）有效弥合了这一差距，并进一步证明自训练方法可以成功内化这种能力，从而在生成过程中实现隐式推理。此外，对于知识迁移任务，我们发现CoT通过帮助检索新学习的知识来辅助生成过程，并且还发现基于查询的架构本身就具有潜在的CoT-like特性，这些特性影响了这一迁移过程。UniSandbox为设计未来真正弥合理解-生成差距的统一架构和训练策略提供了初步见解。

articles.title: Towards Automated Lexicography: Generating and Evaluating Definitions for Learner's Dictionaries
articles.abstract: Dictionary definitions are an essential resource for learning word senses, but manually creating them is costly. We thus study dictionary definition generation (DDG), i.e., the generation of non-contextualized definitions for given headwords. Specifically, we address learner's dictionary definition generation (LDDG), where definitions should be written using simple vocabulary. First, we introduce a reliable evaluation approach for DDG, based on newly proposed evaluation criteria and powered by an LLM-as-a-judge. To provide reference definitions for the evaluation, we construct a dataset of Japanese dictionary definitions in collaboration with a professional lexicographer. Validation results demonstrate that our evaluation approach agrees with human annotators at a level comparable to inter-annotator agreement. Second, we propose an LLM-based LDDG approach that employs iterative simplification. Experimental results show that our approach yields definitions that achieve high scores on the proposed criteria and exhibit high lexical simplicity.
articles.titleCn: 迈向自动化词典编纂：为学习者词典生成与评估定义
articles.abstractCn: 词典定义是学习词义的重要资源，但手动创建词典定义成本高昂。因此，我们研究了词典定义生成（DDG），即针对给定词头生成非上下文化的定义。具体而言，我们关注学习者词典定义生成（LDDG），其中定义应使用简单词汇编写。首先，我们基于新提出的评估标准，并借助大型语言模型作为评判者，引入了一种可靠的DDG评估方法。为了为评估提供参考定义，我们与专业词典学家合作构建了一个日语词典定义数据集。验证结果表明，我们的评估方法与人工标注者的标注一致性达到了与标注者间一致性相当的水平。其次，我们提出了一种基于大型语言模型的LDDG方法，该方法采用迭代简化技术。实验结果表明，我们的方法生成的定义在所提出的标准上获得了高分，并表现出高度的词汇简单性。

articles.title: Stepwise Intrinsic Rewards for Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a widely used paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and Vision-language models (VLMs). Sparse binary outcome rewards, however, score only final correctness and cannot identify which intermediate steps contributed to it; in multimodal tasks, they may also reward answers driven by linguistic priors rather than visual evidence. Process reward models (PRMs) densify supervision but usually require process annotations, auxiliary models, or inference-time search. In this paper, we introduce Stepwise Marginal Information Gain (MIG), an intrinsic process reward computed from the policy itself. MIG measures how each structured reasoning prefix changes the length-normalized, teacher-forced log-likelihood of the reference answer. A monotonic historical watermark rewards only new likelihood maxima, avoiding duplicate credit after sub-record detours. We combine this signal with outcome and format rewards and a gated self-distillation objective that retains only structurally valid and correct trajectories. For VLMs, a real-versus-blank likelihood gate down-weights rewards when answers remain predictable without the image. Across eight task-specific benchmarks, the full method exceeds outcome-only GRPO in every single-run comparison. In broad-data transfer, it improves average accuracy by up to 4.8 points over binary-reward training and gains 12.6 points on MathVerse. At 7B, it exceeds an external PRM-BoN@16 baseline by 12.9 points on vision-language transfer without inference-time reranking. These results support policy-derived stepwise credit as an annotation-free alternative to explicit process reward modeling.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型推理中的逐步内在奖励
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）推理能力的一种广泛应用范式。然而，稀疏的二进制结果奖励仅评估最终正确性，无法识别导致该结果的中间步骤；在多模态任务中，它们还可能奖励由语言先验而非视觉证据驱动的答案。过程奖励模型（PRMs）通过增加监督，但通常需要过程标注、辅助模型或推理时搜索。在本文中，我们引入了逐步边际信息增益（MIG），这是一种从策略本身计算出的内在过程奖励。MIG衡量每个结构化推理前缀如何改变参考答案的长度归一化、教师强制对数似然。单调历史水印仅奖励新的似然最大值，避免在子记录绕行后重复分配信用。我们将此信号与结果和格式奖励相结合，并引入一个门控自蒸馏目标，该目标仅保留结构有效且正确的轨迹。对于VLMs，真实与空白似然门在答案在没有图像时仍可预测时降低奖励权重。在八个特定任务的基准测试中，完整方法在每次运行比较中均优于仅使用结果的GRPO。在广泛数据迁移中，它比二进制奖励训练平均准确率提高高达4.8分，并在MathVerse上提升12.6分。在7B规模下，它在不进行推理时重新排序的情况下，在视觉语言迁移上比外部PRM-BoN@16基线高12.9分。这些结果支持策略推导的逐步信用作为无需显式过程奖励建模的无标注替代方案。

articles.title: Affective Flow Language Model for Emotional Support Conversation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced emotional support conversation, but existing alignment methods rely mainly on sparse preferences at the response level or outcomes at the dialogue level, providing limited supervision for sequential strategy decisions in multi-turn interactions. This raises a key question: how can detailed process signals be derived from overall dialogue outcomes to guide the gradual adaptation of support strategies? We propose the Affective Flow Language Model (AFlow), which models multi-turn emotional support as an affective utility flow evolving along dialogue trajectories. AFlow searches diverse support trajectories and estimates the utility of intermediate dialogue states and candidate strategies. It further introduces Affective Flow Preference Optimization (AFPO), which uses a flow-balance objective defined over dialogue subpaths to propagate downstream preference signals to intermediate states and learn strategy transitions consistent with support outcomes over the full dialogue. AFlow introduces flow-balance learning into multi-turn affective interaction, providing a process-based approach to dynamic affect modeling and continuous strategy optimization. Experiments on ExTES and ESConv show consistent improvements in strategy alignment, response diversity, and generation quality across different model environments and evaluation settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/chz2025/AffectiveFlow.

articles.titleCn: 情感支持对话中的情感流语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在情感支持对话方面取得了进步，但现有的对齐方法主要依赖于响应层面的稀疏偏好或对话层面的结果，为多轮交互中的序列策略决策提供了有限的监督。这提出了一个关键问题：如何从整体对话结果中推导出详细的进程信号，以指导支持策略的逐步适应？我们提出了情感流语言模型（AFlow），将多轮情感支持建模为沿着对话轨迹演变的情感效用流。AFlow搜索多样化的支持轨迹，并估计中间对话状态和候选策略的效用。它进一步引入了情感流偏好优化（AFPO），该优化使用定义在对话子路径上的流平衡目标，将下游偏好信号传播到中间状态，并学习与完整对话支持结果一致的策略转换。AFlow将流平衡学习引入多轮情感交互，为动态情感建模和持续策略优化提供了一种基于进程的方法。在ExTES和ESConv上的实验表明，在不同模型环境和评估设置下，策略对齐、响应多样性和生成质量均取得了持续改进。我们的代码可在https://github.com/chz2025/AffectiveFlow获取。

articles.title: FlyAOC: Evaluating Agentic Ontology Curation of Drosophila Scientific Knowledge Bases
articles.abstract: Scientific knowledge bases accelerate discovery by curating findings from primary literature into structured, queryable formats for both human researchers and emerging AI systems. Maintaining these resources requires expert curators to search papers, reconcile evidence across documents, and produce ontology-grounded annotations. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate isolated subtasks, such as named entity recognition or relation extraction, and therefore do not capture this end-to-end workflow. We present FlyAOC to evaluate AI agents on end-to-end agentic ontology curation from scientific literature. Given a gene symbol, a concise FlyBase gene description, access to a 16,898-paper corpus, and ontology resources, agents must search for evidence and recover as many curator-relevant structured annotations as possible. Outputs span standardized function terms, expression patterns, and historical synonyms linking decades of nomenclature. The benchmark includes 7,397 expert-curated annotations across 100 genes drawn from FlyBase, the Drosophila knowledge base. Across four baseline agent harnesses---memorization, fixed pipeline, single-agent, and multi-agent---FlyAOC is sensitive to harness design, model family, and tool-use reliability. These results reveal system-level failure modes that model-only evaluations do not capture. FlyAOC provides a reproducible testbed for retrieval-augmented scientific curation.

articles.titleCn: FlyAOC：评估果蝇科学知识库的代理本体管理
articles.abstractCn: 科学知识库通过将原始文献中的研究成果整理成结构化、可查询的格式，从而加速了发现进程，这些资源既服务于人类研究人员，也服务于新兴的人工智能系统。维护这些资源需要专家策展人员搜索论文、跨文档协调证据，并生成基于本体的注释。现有的基准通常评估孤立的子任务，如命名实体识别或关系抽取，因此无法捕捉这种端到端的流程。我们提出了FlyAOC，用于评估人工智能代理在从科学文献中进行端到端的代理本体策展方面的能力。给定一个基因符号、一份简洁的FlyBase基因描述、对包含16898篇论文的语料库的访问权限以及本体资源，代理必须搜索证据并尽可能恢复与策展人员相关的结构化注释。输出涵盖标准化的功能术语、表达模式和连接数十年命名法的歷史同义词。该基准包含来自FlyBase（果蝇知识库）的100个基因中的7397份专家策展注释。在四种基准代理框架——记忆、固定流程、单代理和多代理——中，FlyAOC对框架设计、模型系列和工具使用可靠性敏感。这些结果揭示了仅模型评估无法捕捉的系统级失效模式。FlyAOC为检索增强的科学策展提供了一个可复现的测试平台。

articles.title: GT-HarmBench: Benchmarking AI Safety Risks Through the Lens of Game Theory
articles.abstract: Frontier AI systems are increasingly capable and deployed in high-stakes multi-agent environments. However, existing AI safety benchmarks largely evaluate single agents, leaving multi-agent risks such as coordination failure and conflict poorly understood. We introduce GT-HarmBench, a benchmark of 1,535 high-stakes scenarios spanning game-theoretic structures such as the Prisoner's Dilemma, Stag Hunt and Chicken. Scenarios are drawn from realistic AI risk contexts in the MIT AI Risk Repository. Across 15 frontier models, agents fail to choose socially beneficial actions in 38% of high-stakes cases, such as military escalation, election manipulation, and medical malpractice. We measure sensitivity to game-theoretic prompt framing and ordering, and analyze reasoning patterns driving failures. We further show that game-theoretic interventions improve socially beneficial outcomes by up to 18%. Our results highlight substantial reliability gaps and provide a broad standardized testbed for studying alignment in multi-agent environments. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/causalNLP/gt-harmbench.

articles.titleCn: 基于博弈论视角的AI安全风险基准测试：GT-HarmBench
articles.abstractCn: 前沿AI系统正变得越来越强大，并在高风险多智能体环境中得到部署。然而，现有的AI安全基准主要评估单个智能体，导致协调失败和冲突等多智能体风险问题理解不足。我们介绍了GT-HarmBench，这是一个包含1535个高风险场景的基准，涵盖囚徒困境、猎鹿博弈和鸡兔赛跑等博弈论结构。这些场景取自MIT AI风险库中的现实AI风险环境。在15个前沿模型中，智能体在高风险情况下38%未能选择社会有益的行动，例如军事升级、选举操纵和医疗失误。我们测量了博弈论提示框架和顺序的敏感性，并分析了导致失败的推理模式。我们进一步表明，博弈论干预措施可将社会有益结果提高高达18%。我们的结果表明存在巨大的可靠性差距，并为研究多智能体环境中的对齐问题提供了一个广泛的标准化测试平台。基准和代码可在https://github.com/causalNLP/gt-harmbench获取。

articles.title: Combee: Scaling Prompt Learning for Self-Improving Language Model Agents
articles.abstract: Recent advances in prompt learning allow large language model agents to acquire task-relevant knowledge from inference-time context without parameter changes. For example, existing methods (like ACE or GEPA) can learn system prompts to improve accuracy based on previous agent runs. However, these methods primarily focus on single-agent or low-parallelism settings. This fundamentally limits their ability to efficiently learn from a large set of collected agentic traces. It would be efficient and beneficial to run prompt learning in parallel to accommodate the growing trend of learning from many agentic traces or parallel agent executions. Yet without a principled strategy for scaling, current methods suffer from quality degradation with high parallelism. To improve both the efficiency and quality of prompt learning, we propose Combee, a novel framework to scale parallel prompt learning for self-improving agents. Combee speeds up learning and enables running many agents in parallel while learning from their aggregate traces without quality degradation. To achieve this, Combee leverages parallel scans and employs an augmented shuffle mechanism; Combee also introduces a dynamic batch size controller to balance quality and delay. Evaluations on AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, Formula, and FiNER demonstrate that Combee achieves up to 17x speedup over previous methods with comparable or better accuracy and equivalent cost.
articles.titleCn: Combee：为自改进语言模型代理扩展提示学习
articles.abstractCn: 最近在提示学习方面的进展使得大型语言模型代理能够在不改变参数的情况下从推理时上下文中获取与任务相关的知识。例如，现有方法（如ACE或GEPA）可以根据先前代理运行来学习系统提示以提高准确性。然而，这些方法主要关注单代理或低并行性设置。这从根本上限制了它们从大量收集的代理轨迹中高效学习的能力。为了适应从大量代理轨迹或并行代理执行中学习的趋势，并行运行提示学习将非常高效且有益。然而，由于缺乏扩展性原则，当前方法在高并行性下会降低质量。为了提高提示学习的效率和准确性，我们提出了Combee，这是一个用于自我改进代理的并行提示学习扩展的新框架。Combee加快了学习速度，并能够在不降低质量的情况下并行运行多个代理并从它们的聚合轨迹中学习。为了实现这一点，Combee利用并行扫描并采用增强的洗牌机制；Combee还引入了一个动态批处理大小控制器来平衡质量和延迟。在AppWorld、Terminal-Bench、Formula和FiNER上的评估表明，Combee比现有方法快17倍，同时实现了相当或更好的准确性，且成本相当。

articles.title: Closing the Speech-Text Gap with Limited Audio for Effective Domain Adaptation in LLM-Based ASR
articles.abstract: Conventional end-to-end automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems rely on paired speech-text data for domain adaptation. Recent LLM-based ASR architectures connect a speech encoder to a large language model via a projection module, enabling adaptation with text-only data. However, this introduces a modality gap, as the LLM is not exposed to the noisy representations produced by the speech projector. We investigate whether small amounts of speech can mitigate this mismatch. We compare three strategies: text-only adaptation, paired speech-text adaptation, and mixed batching (MB), which combines both. Experiments in in-domain and out-of-domain settings show that even limited speech consistently improves performance. Notably, MB using only 10% of the target-domain (less than 4 hours) speech achieves word error rates comparable to, or better than, conventional ASR fine-tuning with the full dataset, indicating that small amounts of speech provide a strong modality-alignment signal.
articles.titleCn: 利用有限音频缩小语音-文本差距，实现基于LLM的ASR的有效领域自适应
articles.abstractCn: 传统的端到端自动语音识别（ASR）系统依赖于配对的语音-文本数据进行领域自适应。基于大型语言模型（LLM）的ASR架构通过投影模块将语音编码器连接到大型语言模型，从而实现仅使用文本数据进行自适应。然而，这引入了模态差距，因为LLM没有接触到由语音投影器产生的噪声表示。我们研究了少量语音是否可以缓解这种不匹配。我们比较了三种策略：仅文本自适应、配对语音-文本自适应和混合批处理（MB），后者结合了两者。在领域内和领域外环境下的实验表明，即使是少量的语音也能持续提升性能。值得注意的是，仅使用10%的目标领域（少于4小时）语音的MB策略实现了与完整数据集的传统ASR微调相当甚至更好的词错误率，这表明少量语音提供了强大的模态对齐信号。

articles.title: UniPrefill: Universal Long-Context Prefill Acceleration via Block-wise Dynamic Sparsification
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, they are becoming increasingly capable while simultaneously demanding ever-longer context lengths. To improve the inference efficiency of long-context processing, several novel low-complexity hybrid architectures have recently been proposed, effectively alleviating the computational burden of long-context inference. However, existing research on long-context prefill acceleration remains predominantly focused on sparse attention mechanisms, which achieve their maximum speedup only on full-attention models. When transferred to emerging architectures--such as linear/full attention hybrids or sliding window/full attention hybrids--these prefill acceleration approaches suffer significant performance degradation. Furthermore, such methods are generally incompatible with continuous batching, making them difficult to integrate into modern inference engines such as vLLM. To this end, we propose UniPrefill, a prefill acceleration framework applicable to virtually any model architecture, which directly accelerates the model's computation at the token level. We further implement UniPrefill as a continuous batching operator and extend vLLM's scheduling strategy to natively support prefill-decode co-processing and tensor parallel for UniPrefill, enabling its seamless integration into vLLM. UniPrefill achieves up to 2.1x speedup in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), with the acceleration becoming increasingly pronounced as the number of concurrent requests grows.
articles.titleCn: UniPrefill：基于分块动态稀疏化的通用长上下文预填充加速方法
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，它们的能力不断增强，同时所需的上下文长度也日益增长。为了提高长上下文处理的推理效率，近期已提出几种新颖的低复杂度混合架构，有效减轻了长上下文推理的计算负担。然而，现有的长上下文预填充加速研究主要集中于稀疏注意力机制，这类方法仅在全注意力模型上达到最大加速效果。当迁移到新兴架构——如线性/全注意力混合模型或滑动窗口/全注意力混合模型时，这些预填充加速方法会遭受显著的性能下降。此外，这类方法通常与连续批处理不兼容，难以集成到现代推理引擎（如vLLM）中。为此，我们提出了UniPrefill，这是一个适用于几乎所有模型架构的预填充加速框架，它直接在token级别加速模型的计算。我们进一步将UniPrefill实现为连续批处理算子，并扩展vLLM的调度策略，以原生支持UniPrefill的预填充-解码协同处理和tensor并行，从而实现其与vLLM的无缝集成。UniPrefill在首次token生成时间（TTFT）上实现了高达2.1倍的加速，并且随着并发请求数量的增加，加速效果愈发显著。

articles.title: StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents, but optimizing them for long-horizon decision making remains difficult because current methods are largely purely reactive, which weakens both exploration and credit assignment over extended trajectories. In this work, we present Strategic Trajectory Abstraction (StraTA), a simple framework that introduces an explicit trajectory-level strategy into agentic reinforcement learning (RL). StraTA samples a compact strategy from the initial task state, conditions subsequent actions on that strategy, and trains strategy generation and action execution jointly with a hierarchical GRPO-style rollout design, further enhanced by diverse strategy rollout and critical self-judgment. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld show that StraTA consistently improves both sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines. StraTA reaches success rates of 93.1% on ALFWorld and 84.2% on WebShop. On SciWorld, StraTA attains a 63.5% overall score, outperforming frontier closed-source models.
articles.titleCn: StraTA：通过策略轨迹抽象激励代理强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作交互式代理，但针对长时程决策进行优化仍然困难，因为当前方法主要是纯反应式的，这削弱了在长期轨迹中的探索和信用分配。在这项工作中，我们提出了战略轨迹抽象（StraTA），这是一个简单的框架，将显式的轨迹级策略引入到代理式强化学习（RL）中。StraTA从初始任务状态中采样一个紧凑策略，根据该策略条件后续动作，并采用分层GRPO风格的展开设计，联合训练策略生成和动作执行，并通过多样化的策略展开和关键自我判断进一步增强。在ALFWorld、WebShop和SciWorld上的实验表明，StraTA始终在强基线之上提高了样本效率和最终性能。StraTA在ALFWorld上达到了93.1%的成功率，在WebShop上达到了84.2%。在SciWorld上，StraTA获得了63.5%的总分，超越了前沿的闭源模型。

articles.title: AcuityBench: Evaluating Clinical Acuity Identification and Uncertainty Alignment
articles.abstract: We introduce AcuityBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether language models identify the appropriate urgency of care from user medical presentations. Existing health benchmarks emphasize medical question answering, broad health interactions, or narrow workflow-specific triage tasks, but they do not offer a unified evaluation of acuity identification across these settings. AcuityBench addresses this gap by harmonizing five public datasets spanning user conversations, online forum posts, clinical vignettes, and patient portal messages under a shared four-level acuity framework ranging from home monitoring to immediate emergency care. The benchmark contains 914 cases, including 697 consensus cases for standard accuracy evaluation and 217 physician-confirmed ambiguous cases for uncertainty-aware evaluation. It supports two complementary task formats: explicit four-way classification in a QA setting, and free-form conversational responses evaluated with a rubric-based judge anchored to the same framework. Across 12 frontier proprietary and open-weight models, we find substantial variation in clear-case acuity accuracy and error direction. Comparing task formats reveals a systematic tradeoff: conversational responses reduce over-triage but increase under-triage relative to QA, especially in higher-acuity cases. In ambiguous cases, no model closely matches the distribution of physician judgments, and model predictions are more concentrated than expert clinical uncertainty. We also compare expert and model adjudication on a subset of maximally ambiguous cases, using those cases to examine the role of clinical uncertainty in label disagreement. Together, these results position acuity identification as a distinct safety-critical capability and show that AcuityBench enables systematic comparison and stress-testing of how well models guide users to the right level of care in real-world health use.

articles.titleCn: AcuityBench：评估临床严重程度识别和不确定性对齐
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了AcuityBench，这是一个用于评估语言模型能否从用户医疗陈述中识别适当护理紧急程度的基准。现有的健康基准侧重于医疗问答、广泛的健康互动或特定工作流程的狭窄分诊任务，但它们并未在这些场景中提供对紧急程度识别的统一评估。AcuityBench通过将涵盖用户对话、在线论坛帖子、临床摘要和患者门户消息的五个公共数据集整合到一个从家庭监测到紧急急救的四级紧急程度框架下，弥补了这一空白。该基准包含914个案例，其中包括697个共识案例用于标准准确度评估和217个医生确认的模糊案例用于不确定性感知评估。它支持两种互补的任务格式：QA环境下的明确四向分类，以及基于评分标准的自由形式对话响应评估。在12个前沿专有和开放权重模型中，我们发现清晰案例的紧急程度准确度和错误方向存在显著差异。比较任务格式揭示了系统性的权衡：对话响应相对于QA减少了过度分诊，但增加了不足分诊，尤其是在高紧急程度案例中。在模糊案例中，没有模型能接近医生判断的分布，模型的预测比专家临床不确定性更集中。我们还比较了专家和模型在最大程度模糊案例上的裁决，使用这些案例来检验临床不确定性在标签分歧中的作用。综合这些结果，将紧急程度识别定位为一种独特的、安全关键的能力，并表明AcuityBench能够系统地比较和测试模型在现实健康应用中如何引导用户选择正确护理级别的效果。

articles.title: Asking For An Old Friend: Diagnosing and Mitigating Temporal Failure Modes in LLM-based Statutory Question Answering
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for legal research, yet their fixed training cutoffs and reliance on static parametric knowledge are at odds with the evolving nature of statutory law. We study two temporal failure modes: post-cutoff staleness, where models apply superseded rules after legislative amendments, and recency bias, where models prefer newer provisions even when a historical version governs the fact pattern. To this end, we present a benchmark of 312 expert-validated, time-sensitive German statutory QA pairs spanning three categories: Post-Cutoff Amendment Questions, Pre-Amendment Questions, and Multi-Provision Pre-Amendment Questions. We evaluate five LLMs by OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek under four inference settings: Vanilla, Web-search, and two retrieval-augmented variants that enforce temporal validity via a fact date extraction and version filtering. Using an LLM-as-a-judge validated against human expert ratings, we find severe degradation in the Vanilla post-cutoff setting. Both RAG approaches substantially improve performance across all question types, while web search yields unstable gains and exhibits a marked recency bias on historically anchored tasks. Our results indicate that reliable legal QA requires treating temporal validity as a hard constraint.

articles.titleCn: 请求一位老朋友：诊断和缓解基于LLM的法规问答中的时间失效模式
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在法律研究中应用日益广泛，但其固定的训练截止日期和依赖静态参数化知识的特点，与成文法的动态发展特性存在矛盾。我们研究了两种时间失效模式：训练截止日期后的陈旧性失效，即模型在立法修订后仍应用失效规则；以及时效偏差，即模型在历史版本规则仍适用于事实情况时，仍倾向于优先使用新规定。为此，我们构建了一个包含312个专家验证、时间敏感的德国成文法问答对基准，涵盖三个类别：训练截止日期后修订问题、修订前问题以及多条款修订前问题。我们使用OpenAI、Anthropic和DeepSeek提供的五种大型语言模型，在四种推理设置下进行评估：纯文本推理、网络搜索增强推理，以及两种通过事实日期提取和版本过滤强制执行时效性的检索增强变体。通过将大型语言模型作为法官进行验证，并与人类专家评分进行对比，我们发现纯文本推理在训练截止日期后设置中性能严重下降。两种检索增强方法均显著提升了所有问题类型的性能，而网络搜索带来的增益不稳定，并在历史锚定任务中表现出明显的时效偏差。我们的结果表明，可靠的法务问答需要将时效性视为硬性约束。

articles.title: Direct Preference Optimization for English-Mandarin Code-Switching Speech Recognition in Audio LLMs
articles.abstract: Audio large language models (Audio LLMs) exhibit systematic failures in transcribing code-switching speech despite strong multilingual capabilities. Focusing on English-Mandarin, we identify three failure modes: language omission, translation-instead-of-transcription, and hallucination. We apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align models, constructing preference pairs in which chosen responses preserve mixed-language content while rejected responses mimic failure patterns. Training three Audio LLMs on 100K pairs (570 hours), we observe consistent behavioral shifts: models learn to preserve language composition rather than translating when prompted for transcription. This alignment yields MER reductions up to 89.6% (in-distribution) and 20.0% (out-of-distribution). Our findings suggest DPO can effectively elicit correct code-switching transcription behavior from multilingual Audio LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 音频大语言模型中英语-普通话代码转换语音识别的直接偏好优化
articles.abstractCn: 尽管音频大型语言模型（Audio LLMs）具备强大的多语言能力，但在转写代码转换语音时仍存在系统性缺陷。针对英汉代码转换，我们识别出三种缺陷模式：语言遗漏、翻译替代转写和幻觉。我们应用直接偏好优化（DPO）进行模型对齐，构建偏好对，其中选定的回复保留混合语言内容，而拒绝的回复则模仿缺陷模式。在10万对（570小时）数据上训练三个Audio LLM后，我们观察到一致的行为转变：模型在转写提示下学会保留语言构成而非翻译。这种对齐使MER（跨分布）降低高达89.6%，（外分布）降低20.0%。我们的研究表明DPO能有效从多语言Audio LLM中引出正确的代码转换转写行为。

articles.title: Generating Legal Commentaries from Case Databases via Retrieval, Clustering, and Generation
articles.abstract: We present a fully automated pipeline that transforms large collections of court decisions into legal commentaries for statutes - without providing any handcrafted doctrinal framework. Using 4.555 decisions of the German Federal Court of Justice that cite sections 242, 280, 812 and 823 of the German Civil Code (BGB), we extract paragraph-level chunks, summarize their reasoning, and derive keywords, which are embedded and clustered. For each cluster, an LLM generates headings and synthesizes citation-rich sections, which are then merged into coherent commentaries by four state-of-the-art LLMs. We evaluate along five dimensions - topical relevance, heading-match, citation faithfulness, cluster distinction and logical ordering - using both a human expert and an LLM-judge. Our results show that commentary-like argument mining from court decisions to generate reports that can be refreshed within minutes at minimal cost is feasible, yet they highlight limitations arising from restricted sources and the normativity of legal reasoning.

articles.titleCn: 通过检索、聚类和生成从案例数据库中生成法律评论
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种全自动化的流程，将大量法院判决转化为法律条文评注——无需提供任何手工制作的学说框架。利用德国联邦最高法院引用德国民法典（BGB）第242、280、812和823条的4,555个判决，我们提取段落级别的文本块，总结其推理过程，并提取关键词，这些关键词被嵌入并聚类。对于每个聚类，一个大型语言模型（LLM）生成标题，并综合引用丰富的段落，然后由四个最先进的LLM将其合并成连贯的评注。我们沿五个维度——主题相关性、标题匹配度、引用忠实度、聚类区分度和逻辑排序度——使用人类专家和LLM法官进行评估。我们的结果表明，从法院判决中提取评注式论证生成可在几分钟内以最低成本更新的报告是可行的，但同时也突出了由于信息来源受限和法律推理的规范性而产生的局限性。

articles.title: Large Language Model Selection with Limited Annotations
articles.abstract: Choosing a Large Language Model (LLM) for a given task requires comparing many strong candidates, yet standard evaluation relies on costly annotations over fixed evaluation sets. To address this challenge, we develop SELECT-LLM, the first framework for active model selection of LLMs. SELECT-LLM aims to find a small set of queries whose annotations are most informative for identifying the best LLM for a given task. To this end, we introduce a query selection rule based on expected information gain, computed from pairwise similarities between candidate model outputs. Because this rule only uses generated model responses, SELECT-LLM can be applied across candidate models without assumptions about their architecture or access to model weights. This makes it suitable for both open-weight and black-box LLMs. We evaluate SELECT-LLM across 23 datasets, 156 evaluated models, diverse task families, and multiple text evaluation metrics. Across all experiments, SELECT-LLM improves over the strongest baseline in every setting, with annotation cost reductions up to 81.8% for best model selection and up to 84.78% for near-best model selection.
